status_detail: Box Elder County approved consent for MIDA to create the Stratos project area on May 4, 2026; Phase 1 has been reported as a 3 GW initial commitment, but MIDA later said it was awaiting permit requests and the project remained under public and political review.
notes: Part of the broader 7.5-9 GW Stratos/Wonder Valley AI data center and on-site power proposal in western Box Elder County.

status_detail: Cleanview tracks a 6 GW planned expansion on the same roughly 40,000-acre Stratos/Wonder Valley project area; broader project approvals and permitting remain contested and evolving.

project_name: High Performance Compute Data Center Campus
aliases: Joule Capital Partners Energy and Data Center Campus
status_detail: Joule says it is master-planning an energy and data center campus in Millard County with heavy industrial zoning, an executed conditional-use permit, and behind-the-meter on-site power; Cleanview tracks 4,000 MW planned capacity.
notes: BNEF reported a 4,000-acre Utah campus with 1.5 GW of first-phase captive power; Cleanview lists 4 GW data center capacity.

status_detail: Utah GOEO said Creekstone's Millard County power and AI data center project began construction in late 2025; Cleanview tracks the first data center phase at 300 MW on 1,143 acres.
notes: Integrated behind-the-meter natural gas and solar power campus near Delta.

status_detail: Cleanview tracks a 9.7 GW planned expansion of Creekstone's Delta Gigasite; official Utah economic-development release describes a large-scale power and AI data center campus near Delta with on-site generation.

aliases: Red Butte Energy and Data Center Campus
status_detail: BrightNight describes an Iron County campus about 8 miles north of Newcastle with a 1.5 GW data center and over 2 GW of hybrid power systems; Iron County says the Red Butte data center application was submitted May 4, 2026, deemed incomplete May 22, 2026, and is on hold under a 180-day moratorium.
notes: Application is not currently in process because of the Iron County moratorium; keep as announced/planned lead.

status_detail: Cleanview tracks a planned 1.5 GW data center in Iron County on 640 acres with 1.35 million square feet, developed by Pronghorn Development LLP.

aliases: Dugway Proving Ground Hyperscale Data Center

notes: Conditional federal selection, not an operational or fully permitted campus.

notes: Cleanview tracks 400 MW and expected 2029 operation; local materials identify Nine Mile Data LLC and Energence-related filings.
